This resource is provided by Sakki, Georgia Konstantina; Efstratiadis, Andreas. Coverage is city as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists R formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The short provider description does not document input variables, simulation period or validation. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
